title: Daddy's Blue Mug
can_do: 帮没找到东西的大人说清物品特征（颜色、图案、位置），直到找到。

conversation_move.label: describe an item clearly enough to find it

trigger: Dad cannot find his own mug and does not remember what it looks like, so Child describes it.
setting: A busy morning in the kitchen.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I can't find my mug anywhere this morning.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Did you look next to the coffee maker?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Not yet. What does my mug look like?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It's dark blue, with a little white cloud on it.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Oh, the one from our beach trip!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, that one. I put it back last night.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: There it is. Thank you, my helper!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The light-blue mug is Mom's. Don't mix them up!

replay_cards.title: Mom's missing keys
replay_cards.setting: Mom cannot find her keys before shopping.
replay_cards.change: Two key rings sit in the bowl by the door.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes Mom's ring as the round one with the blue bead, and remembers where he last saw it.

replay_cards.title: The lost remote
replay_cards.setting: Dad wants his show but the remote is gone.
replay_cards.change: The sofa has many cushions and blankets.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes the remote as the thin black one with the red button, and suggests looking between the middle cushions.

parent_support: 大人偶尔“记不清”自己的东西，把描述的机会让给孩子。
孩子说了颜色后追问一句“还有什么记号”，帮他凑齐两个特征。
找到后一句话总结：“你说清了颜色和云朵，就找到了。”
